faq.question: Can I bring cigarettes to Singapore?
faq.answer: Singapore allows you to bring duty-paid cigarettes, but there is ZERO duty-free allowance. You must declare every pack at the Red Channel at Changi Airport and pay tax. E-cigarettes are strictly banned.

faq.question: What is Lufthansa cigarette allowance?
faq.answer: For travelers arriving in Germany from outside the EU on Lufthansa, the duty-free allowance is 200 cigarettes (or 50 cigars) for passengers aged 17 and older.
